text:
If you have leftover cooked dry pasta (as was left today because there was too little tomato soup left to use it all up), you can throw the pasta into oil in a pan. Add either small tomatoes cut in halves or diced thick tomato slices, add spices (dried basil was enough for me), and fry everything together for a short while!
I don't have a photo, but I can assure you it is tasty, and vegan. A good struggle meal indeed.
